CHOOSE YOUR STARTING POINT

Support with a clear purpose.

Property Reality Check

Make the visit count.

An authorised site visit or live video viewing focused on your needs, the listing’s claims and the questions you want answered.

  • Your priorities and concerns gathered before the visit
  • Dated observations of visible condition, access and surroundings
  • Available building or management information, clearly attributed
  • A practical summary of differences, unanswered questions and recommended specialist checks

BUILT AROUND YOUR SITUATION

Work with the people
already involved.

You can engage us even if you are buying through another agent. We work with the people already involved, with clear permission and a defined brief.

What to keep in mind

An ordinary visit does not establish legal title, structural condition or investment value. Observations, seller-supplied information and specialist findings are kept distinct. Any negotiation or representation requires an agreed mandate.

CLEAR BEFORE WE START

Your scope. Your quote.

The quote depends on location, property type, the concern, urgency, number of visits and specialist input. We agree the coordination period, reports, access and approval limits before starting.

Legal work, technical inspections, repairs and materials are separately scoped unless explicitly included. No published rates or automatic subscriptions apply.
